title: Spatial interpolation of dissolved oxygen, Chesapeake Bay
method: Average the 26 455 DO samples (MeasureValue, mg/L) per station (131 stations), interpolate the station means with Gaussian kernel regression (Nadaraya-Watson; bandwidth 10 km by leave-one-out CV) on a 500 m grid clipped to the Bay polygon (EPSG:32618) and map it. IDW, kriging, splines, nearest-station and surface-/bottom-layer aggregations are accepted.

key_parameters.aggregation: station mean of all samples (surface or bottom layer accepted)

benchmark_defects: The instruction's output name is misspelt ('interploated_water_quality.png'); the reference uses it, the checks also accept the corrected spelling.

The Domain Knowledge recommends KDE for interpolating values; a value-weighted KDE estimates a weighted sampling density, not the DO value. The published reference script uses scipy gaussian_kde with weights=MeasureValue. The reference solution here uses kernel regression (the value-interpolating kernel method).

The samples are depth profiles over two years; the task does not say which depth/time to map. Layer choice changes the pattern drastically (all-depth vs surface station means: Spearman 0.11), so three aggregations are accepted.
checks: required: map present (instructed misspelt name or corrected)

required: the DRAWN field, placed by its own georeference (imshow extent+origin; pixel-space images on the Bay/sample bbox; pcolormesh cell bboxes; scatter offsets+values or the colour-matched captured point layer; contour/contourf/tricontourf calls evaluated on captured arrays; lon/lat projected) and then taken in any of the 8 orientations within its own bounding box, sampled at 11 789 Bay cells, has Spearman >= 0.65 with an IDW yardstick (all-depth, surface or bottom station means); nothing placeable -> UNVERIFIABLE

required: drawn values are DO in mg/L (mean within 1 mg/L of the yardstick, p1-p99 in [0, 20]); a display-rescaled image is accepted when it is a linear function (r >= 0.99) of an output GeoTIFF in mg/L
optional: a DO surface computed (any captured grid, all orientations)
optional: surface clipped to the Bay
figure (kind=figure, not in the main metric): the drawn field as georeferenced, without re-orientation, has Spearman >= 0.65
